responsibility: Implements the tree vectorizer’s data-reference analysis and memory-access support logic for both loop and basic-block vectorization. It classifies loads and stores seen in stmt_vec_info/data_reference records, computes scalar and vector types for memory operations, analyzes strides, groups, dependence-relevant layout, and alignment/misalignment properties, and decides whether accesses can be handled directly, by realignment, or by target-specific lane/gather/scatter-style mechanisms using target vector hooks and optabs; it also provides the memory-reference utilities that later transformation code consumes when generating vector loads, stores, and alignment/versioning decisions.
